messages:
anya: Bringing up HF model 'mistral-mini-fork' — hit a weird conversion issue from HF Jinja chat_template -> Redwood prompt. Empty system block gets dropped after render and the tokenizer then glues role sentinels, causing a quality regression on summarization evals.

kevin: ugh — can you paste the original chat_template and the rendered prompt you feed into the tokenizer?

anya: sure, template snippet (simplified):
```jinja
{% if system %}{{ system }}{% endif %}
{% for m in messages %}
- role: {{ m.role }}
  content: {{ m.content }}
{% endfor %}
```
Rendered when system is empty (what RW sees):
```
- role: user
  content: write a short summary
- role: assistant
  content: ...
```
The problem is HF uses `<|system|>` sentinel in some configs and when system is empty the sentinel disappears entirely and tokenizer starts splitting the role markers across tokens.

julie: that rings a bell — we saw similar with special token splitting. If `<|system|>` is not in `additional_special_tokens` the BPE can produce `<|` and `system|>` pieces which then get merged into neighboring text. Two fixes:
1) add the sentinel to tokenizer via `tokenizer.add_special_tokens({'additional_special_tokens':['<|system|>']})`
2) or in conversion, preserve empty system by emitting an explicit empty system role: `system: ""` so RW's prompt pipeline never drops it.

eval-bot: quick perf snapshot:
- baseline (hosted fp16): ROUGE-L 46.2
- converted + quant int8: ROUGE-L 42.9  (delta -3.3)
- ppl on dev set: baseline 12.1 -> quant 13.1 (+8%)
(see run 1777777777)

bench-bot: benchmark uploaded: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/1777777777 : includes tokenization diffs and token-level alignments.

anya: small workaround that helped locally: replace sentinel with a private-use char before tokenization, e.g. `text = text.replace('<|system|>','\uF020')` so tokenizer keeps it intact. But that's hacky and could break downstream IO.

kevin: agree hacky. I'll draft a conversion patch: when converting HF chat_template to RW prompt, if system block is falsy emit `system: ""` and also inject any HF special tokens into the tokenizer mapping if missing. Will add tests for tokenizer boundary cases.

julie: also check `config.json` mapping — some HF models set `bos_token` to `<|system|>` (ugh). If bos==system and system is dropped the token positions shift. Add explicit mapping in conversion: `bos->bos`, `system->system` and never alias them implicitly.

anya: thanks — marking as blocker for bring-up and adding an eval job after the PR. I'll paste failing sample inputs into the issue.

kevin: thx. if you can include the `tokenizer.encode` dumps for the failing examples that'll speed up debugging.

anya: will do this afternoon. cc @julie for the special tokens mapping.

(emoji: :eyes:)
